blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.productCollection` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method creates a product collection. It sends a request to the 
[Create Collection](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#collections\_postcollections)
API route.

types.description: The details of the product collection to create.

children.name: title

children.name: handle
children.description: The collection's handle.

children.name: external_id
children.description: An external ID for the collection.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Key-value pairs of custom data.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the product collection.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).
